cp2k/dbcsr.manifest:
name="dbcsr"
version="0.0.0"
license="GPL-2.0-or-later"
[library]
source-dir="playground-library"
include-dir=["src", "src/acc", "src/acc/cuda", "src/acc/hip", "src/base", "src/block", "src/core", "src/data", "src/dist", "src/mm", "src/mpi", "src/ops", "src/tas", "src/tensors", "src/utils", "src/work"]
[build]
auto-executables=false
auto-examples=false
auto-tests=false
external-modules=["libxs", "libxs_jit", "mpi", "mpi_f08", "omp_lib"]
link=["openblas"]
[install]
library=true
[preprocess.cpp]
macros=["NDEBUG", "__STATM_TOTAL", "__SHORT_FILE__=__FILE__"]
[fortran]
implicit-external=true

scope: The upstream CMake-selected serial CPU library is rendered with Fypp 3.2, with exact generated-output hashes. Simple USE lists emitted from Python sets are sorted for reproducibility across Python versions and platforms; numerical algorithms are unchanged. MPI, OpenMP, GPU, LIBXS and LIBXSMM are disabled, and the library links pinned OpenBLAS. The diagnostic filename macro uses __FILE__. The checked main creates two 4-by-4 block-sparse matrices, multiplies them through dbcsr_multiply, reconstructs the result and independently compares it with MATMUL, requiring finite entries and a small maximum error. D1 covers matrix operations. Parallel scaling, accelerators and tensor operations are outside this verification scope. GPL-2.0-or-later notices are retained. The wrapper repeats the base-hooks USE list so FPM can order dependencies hidden in the original include. Its manifest permits legacy implicit external BLAS/LAPACK calls; runtime and bounds checks remain enabled.
initial_preparation_findings: Fypp templates emit unordered USE lists; the adapter sorts simple identifier-only lists, including continuations, before hashing. This produces identical checked Fortran on Windows and GNU/Linux without changing numerical operations. FPM did not discover base-hooks dependencies in the original CPP include; checksum-guarded staging edits repeat exactly that include's USE imports. The source manifest enables implicit external procedures, as required by legacy BLAS/LAPACK calls; an attempted environment warning override was ineffective and is not retained. Runtime and bounds checks remain active. The diagnostic macro uses __FILE__. MPI, OpenMP, LIBXS, LIBXSMM and accelerators are disabled.
generated_source_support: See ../../fpm-generated-sources.md. Original sources remain in local exports. DBCSR preparation needs Fypp 3.2; visitors do not run CMake.
